package.name: arm_gazebo
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic (gz-sim 8) closed-loop simulation for the 3-DoF delta arm. This independent package hosts everything Gazebo: the URDF model of the delta mechanism (open kinematic tree with DetachableJoint runtime loop closure), the DART/pgs world, the arm_cmd_bridge node that feeds the arm controller's joint commands (arm/motor_targets, degrees) to the simulated shoulder servos (cmd_pos, radians), and the launch files. Kept fully separate from the core `arm` package (which talks to real hardware).
